aiVerification.summary: Draft uses citeable rows but misgroups the UV machine-off test and compares results to the wrong normal baselines.
issues: Changed factor is mislabeled and mixes line/type with condition.
Change domain incorrectly includes dimension/spec despite spec unchanged.
Rows from Jan24 and Jan26 are compared to Jan23 normal instead of same-date normal rows.
Overall improved judgement is unsafe; Jan26 appears worse versus its same-date normal.
Measurement outcome is spurious table parsing, not a separate measurement study.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to normal 2 Dry UV machines vs turning off 1 machine/use 1 Dry UV.
Use date/test round and Dry UV2/Dry UV3 setup as subgroup keys.
Compare Jan23 tests to Test!19, Jan24 tests to Test!25, and Jan26 test to Test!29.
Revise judgements per subgroup and avoid one blanket improved conclusion.
Remove or reclassify the parsed measurement outcome as defect-category counts only.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist, but outcome evidence is insufficient until same-date baseline rows and grouping context are used.
